picks.title: Unity unveils Unity 7 roadmap with an update path that won't break your build
picks.headline: Unity unveils Unity 7 roadmap with an update path that won't break your build
picks.excerpt: Unity's Unity 7 roadmap adds a CLI/public API and a free MCP server that wires coding agents directly into the engine, so creators and AI agents can validate assets, push builds, and collaborate side by side — framed as optional, with no breaking changes from Unity 6.
picks.rationale: Most actionable of the pool: a free MCP server plus CLI/public API lets AI coding agents drive the engine directly, changing how Unity devs script builds and validate assets tomorrow — with an explicit no-breaking-changes upgrade path.

picks.title: NVIDIA DLSS 5 hands over full control to artists to 'direct the final frame'
picks.headline: NVIDIA DLSS 5 hands over full control to artists to 'direct the final frame'
picks.excerpt: A SIGGRAPH technical demo shows DLSS 5's neural rendering pipeline handing artists control to 'direct the final frame,' using a one-step pixel-space diffusion transform to reach 4K, life-like visuals on a single GPU. A craft shift: AI upscaling moves from a black box to a directable creative tool in the art pipeline.
picks.rationale: Novel craft shift from SIGGRAPH: neural upscaling turns from a black box into a directable tool artists can steer, giving game art teams new authorship over the final rendered frame.

picks.title: 'It creates lesser games': Indie studios are supposed to love generative AI, so why do the 25 devs I spoke to avoid it?
picks.headline: 'It creates lesser games': Indie studios are supposed to love generative AI, so why do the 25 devs I spoke to avoid it?
picks.excerpt: Indie studios are supposedly the natural adopters of generative AI, yet 25 developers explain why they keep it out of their craft — arguing the tools 'create lesser games' and erode the hand-made quality players can feel. A grounded look at why the workflow promise isn't landing with small teams.
picks.rationale: Reported insight from 25 named indie devs on why generative-AI workflows don't hold up in practice — a grounded counterweight that helps designers weigh where the tools actually help versus hurt the finished game.

picks.title: All The Video Game Studios That Refuse To Use Generative AI
picks.headline: All The Video Game Studios That Refuse To Use Generative AI
picks.excerpt: A running roll-call of game studios publicly pledging to keep generative AI out of their development, with devs framing it as a craft-and-values stance — 'ownership of the work has to be traceable' and 'AI art will never match sentient creation' — a counterweight to the industry's AI-adoption push.
picks.rationale: Freshest item (2026-07-29): a living directory of studios publicly refusing generative AI, useful signal on where the craft-and-provenance line is being drawn across the industry; distinct in outlet and framing from the GamesRadar indie-devs feature.
